rationale: Reconnaissance of all five tables, so every optional component is switched on and defaults that truncate coverage are overridden. load_tables + schema_summary give the per-table data contract (data_contract.json). missingness uses scope=all_columns rather than top_10 because the task asks for every column of every table and needs the fully-empty columns named (manifest shows dx3-dx5, modifier1/2, denial_reason_desc, auth_number all-null in medical_claims). duplicate_check tests the natural key of each table plus adherence.member_id alone next to the composite member_id+therapeutic_class, so the report shows why the composite key is required (10,627 rows vs 500 members). date_ranges covers all three medical_claims date columns with consistency_checks=true to count adjudication-before-service-end and end-before-start rows; the pharmacy and enrollment date columns are added because later tasks depend on those windows. join_check verifies the six catalogue relationships: both claims tables and adherence to members, rendering and billing NPI to providers, and pharmacy_npi to providers to establish whether pharmacy claims can be joined to the directory at all (manifest indicates no_match, 18,310/18,310 unmatched). write_report includes the required synthetic_data and sample_preview caveats plus descriptive_only, with show_denominators=true so every unmatched/duplicate rate prints as numerator/denominator and cite_artifacts=true so each number traces to an artifact or metrics key. No skills were provided in this baseline request.
